notes: IdentityUnits is a fee-free ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 UI to msg.sender once. It exposes no further minting or administrative powers. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool fee is 0.3%. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), assuming IdentityUnits is currency0. The deployer derives the actual opening price from the supplied economics, totalSupply and currency ordering.
